quote: When excluding full-season CCs from analyses, CCs increased cash crop yields by 9% ± 2% on average (i.e., for all cash crops together; p = 0.0119; n = 2026 observation), by 11% ± 4% in corn (p = 0.0250) and by 11% ± 2% in small grain cereals (p = 0.0024), while CC effect on soybean yield remained non-significant (p = 0.0862; Appendix D).
